name: fabio-provider-native-metric-schema-preflight
instr:
fabio cannot discover provider-native metric identities, restrictions, or collisions before creating instruments or changing routing state. Add offline metric-schema preflight whose accepted plans exactly predict runtime registration and emission, while invalid prospective routing leaves active service behavior intact. Accepted or disabled preflight must preserve configuration precedence, output encoding, scaling, disabled-provider behavior, and instruments whose kind and ordered labels equal their planned descriptors. Expose `PreflightMode` from `github.com/fabiolb/fabio/config`; `ProviderPlan` contains `Provider string` and `Metrics []MetricPlan`.

`CompileCatalog` in `github.com/fabiolb/fabio/metrics` must validate every `MetricDescriptor` before planning, create no instruments, and deterministically return one `ProviderPlan` per configured `Provider`, with a `MetricPlan` for every supplied descriptor in descriptor insertion order. Catalog compilation must report every provider-visible identity collision together in stable descriptor insertion order while retaining all nonconflicting plans for caller inspection and correction. Every planning failure must be exposed as a `Conflict` whose stable caller-readable fields and `Error` formatting identify its `ConflictKind`, provider, descriptor indexes, and involved backend identity.
